reviews.title: Porn ads
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this for a while and enjoying the skill drills. Today, while doing the activity to complete pictures with a single line without overlap or lifting a finger, an ad banner appeared across the bottom with pornographic pictures. I am a 60 year old woman, so I have to assume these weren’t directed to me but part of the ad program. Offensive to say the least. I uninstalled and would recommend that you not install this game.
